questions.question: Goliath, the giant Philistine champion, shouted a challenge across the valley to Israel's army. What did he want them to do?

answers.text: Choose one man to fight him
Send their whole army down at once
Give up and go back home

questions.question: When the whole Israelite army was afraid of the giant Philistine, what did the young shepherd David offer to do?

answers.text: Go and fight the giant himself
Go home and bring more men
Play the harp for the troops

questions.question: Before fighting Goliath, David said the LORD would give him victory. What did David say the whole world would then know?

answers.text: That there is a God in Israel
That David is a mighty warrior
That Saul is a great king
